Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `web` in namespace `drift-lab` was changed live to 3 replicas and image `nginx:1.26-alpine` (revision 2, ReplicaSet `web-7688bbc54d`), which no longer matches the desired manifests in `desired/` (2 replicas, `nginx:1.27-alpine`).

EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab diff -f desired/` exited with code 1 (differences, not an error). Live `spec.replicas: 3` vs desired `2`; live `image: docker.io/library/nginx:1.26-alpine` vs desired `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpine`; live `metadata.generation: 3` vs desired `4`. (Verified by me with this command.)
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n drift-lab rs -l app=web -o custom-columns=...`: `web-7688bbc54d` is REVISION 2, CHANGE-CAUSE `<none>`, DESIRED 3, READY 3, image `nginx:1.26-alpine`; `web-6c66b6776c` is REVISION 1, CHANGE-CAUSE `<none>`, DESIRED 0, image `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n drift-lab events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp`: `Scaled down replica set web-6c66b6776c from 1 to 0` and `Scaled up replica set web-7688bbc54d from 0 to 1`, followed by `Pulled` of `nginx:1.26-alpine` for the new pods.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n drift-lab pods -l app=web -o wide`: 3 pods, all `1/1 Running`, `RESTARTS 0`, on `sre-lab-worker` and `sre-lab-worker2`. No crash, so no logs were read.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n drift-lab deploy/web -o jsonpath={.metadata.annotations}`: `last-applied-configuration` records `"replicas":2` and `nginx:1.27-alpine`, matching `desired/`; the live spec was changed after that apply, and `desired/` was not updated.

FIX (not applied): `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab apply -f desired/` (sets `web` back to 2 replicas and `nginx:1.27-alpine`).

Fact.Value: `kubectl diff -f desired/` exit 1 (differences, not an error)
